name: Journey into Thunder Bluff
summary: The spirits send you from Mulgore to Thunder Bluff after the Rites of the Earthmother. Cairne Bloodhoof, High Chieftain of the tauren, awaits you there.

sections.title: A Rite of Passage Concluded
sections.body: Across Mulgore, the Rites of the Earthmother test your strength, vision, and wisdom. The trials lead across the plains and through the land’s ancestral sites. When the Ancestral Spirit acknowledges your final rite, you have proved yourself worthy to enter Thunder Bluff as a defender of the tauren people.

sections.title: Ascending to the High Rise
sections.body: From the sacred ground where spirits wander, you travel upward to Thunder Bluff. The city crowns red stone mesas, joined by rope bridges and great wooden elevators. Cairne Bloodhoof, High Chieftain of the tauren, awaits you on the High Rise, ready to greet those who have followed the ancestors’ path.

faq.q: Who sends you on this journey?
faq.answer: An Ancestral Spirit sends you after you complete the Rite of Wisdom, the final step in the traditional Rites of the Earthmother.

faq.q: Where can I find Cairne Bloodhoof?
faq.answer: Cairne Bloodhoof awaits you on the High Rise, Thunder Bluff’s central mesa above the red plateaus and plains.

faq.q: What is the significance of completing this quest?
faq.answer: Reaching Cairne marks your formal graduation from Mulgore’s starting adventures. The tauren leadership recognizes you, and you are ready to take on duties across the Horde.

faq.q: Do only tauren complete this journey?
aliases: who can do journey to thunder bluff
faq.answer: The journey is a traditional tauren rite of passage. Any member of the Horde who proves their dedication through the Rites of the Earthmother receives the same honor and is sent to meet the High Chieftain.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Cairne?
faq.answer: Cairne welcomes you to his home and acknowledges your deeds. He points you toward the wider conflicts facing the Horde across Kalimdor.

faq.q: How do you reach the High Rise in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Take the great mechanical elevators from the plains below to the mesas. Then cross the rope and timber bridges to the central High Rise platform, where the Chieftain’s lodge stands.

angles.text: As a young tauren, standing before Cairne Bloodhoof after the Earthmother’s rites marks your passage into adulthood and earns you tribal honor.
As a member of the Horde, you see its peoples’ mutual respect when the tauren welcome allied races who complete their sacred traditions.
